macros.name: liningstylenums
macros.doc: The \liningstylenums command or liningnums environment selects the lining style figures font.

macros.name: tfprintfigures
macros.doc: Prints a small exhibit of numeric text in different shapes and weights, including output from math, liningnums and textnums environments and from \textstylenums and \oldstylenums commands.

macros.name: tfprintinfo
macros.doc: Prints roman, substitute text figures (if specified), sans serif, teletype, math and symbols typeface information, including TeX font name, em size, ex height, and scale factor metrics.

macros.name: tfprintmathsample
macros.doc: Prints a small block of math-oriented prose, including calligraphic, blackboard and greek fonts where defined.

macros.name: tfprinttext
macros.doc: Prints a small exhibit of alphanumeric text in different shapes and weights.

macros.name: tfprinttextalphabets
macros.doc: Prints math, rm, sf and tt intermixed lines of lowercase, uppercase and numeric text.

macros.name: tfprinttextsample
macros.doc: Prints a small block of prose.

envs.name: liningnums
envs.doc: The \liningstylenums command or liningnums environment selects the lining style figures font.
